participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Kept Tuesday's reading at his father's house, and kept Sunday's supper clear of a roll.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Asked for a roll, was refused, and took Tuesday as the day.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You named the afternoons and left every roll with Abel. Heminges refused a share and left the coffer shut. Kemp will wait until Tuesday. Supper tomorrow was named, and Greenwich was named as a place you are not sent.
